changelog:
Initial release of the Alibaba Cloud OOS Template Generation skill.

- Provides intelligent generation of OOS automation templates based on user O&M requirements.
- Supports querying available OOS Actions and OpenAPIs via CLI and OpenMeta.
- Validates template syntax and semantics before output, with iterative error correction.
- Enforces strict security: never prints or requests credentials; checks config status only.
- Requires confirmation of all user-customizable parameters before template generation.
- Details mandatory workflow, permission checks, standard CLI practices, and lifecycle management.
